source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-11

procedures.title: Steering column: remove
steps: Corvette: on the engine side of the dash panel, remove the clamp bolt and washer from the support assembly (see figure 20 in the manual).
Corvette: remove the screws holding the support assembly and seal to the engine side of the dash panel.
Support the column and remove the screws, nuts and bolts holding the instrument panel mounting bracket to the underside of the panel.
Slide the seat fully rearward and carefully lift the column up and out of the car.
notes: Wedge shims and retainers at the bracket are noted only for other models.
